method_note: This plan blends three pillars: (1) optional Nicotine Replacement Therapy (patches, lozenges, gum) to soften physical withdrawal, (2) an oral substitute kit (peppermints, sugar-free gum, toothpicks, cinnamon sticks) for the hand-to-mouth habit, and (3) mindset work inspired by the Easyway approach: smoking gives no genuine pleasure, cravings are the addiction dying, and quitting is an escape, not a sacrifice. NRT dosing shown is standard over-the-counter guidance; users should confirm their dose and schedule with a pharmacist or doctor, especially if pregnant, under 18, or managing a heart condition.
